The Laser Blade: Shrouded in mystery and with varying reports of its weight and length, many say it does not even exist. When sheathed, the sword has no blade, the blade's energy beam only appears when it is swung. The blade is semi-flexible and glows with a purple aura, making it resemble a whip, Innocent Devil: The creatures that can only be created by a Devil Forgemaster like Isaac. He has various type of his devils to use in a fight., Fairy-Type: The small creatures in shape of a fairy. They are relatively weak but have useful abilities to support Isaac such as healing, poison powder, lullaby and invisible magic., Battle-Type: There are several different shapes of this type, such as the golem, skullknight, samurai-like, liquid golem, etc. they're useful to fight in combat., Bird-Type: The flying creatures in shape of birds or dragons. The Bird-Type is stronger than the Fairy-Type but weaker than the Devil-Type or Battle-Type. It's very agile, giving it an advantage over ground enemies. They can easily defeat light enemies by juggling them but suffer against armored or heavy enemies., Mage-Type: The wizard-like Innocent Devils. They are the only true magic-users of the Innocent Devils by casting elemental magic and time stop., Devil-Type: The winged-devil. They're considered a balance between the Battle-Type and the Bird-Type, as they can fly and perform Chain-Attacks with Isaac. They can use the Magic Circle ability to allow Isaac to hidden in Magic Circle. As they advance, they can cause spikes, blades and powerful explosions to issue from the Magic Circle., Pumpkin-Type: The small devils with Jack O'Lantern head. they are among the weakest with the fairies will be completely vulnerable while performing one. However, they give a large boost to all stats, making Isaac very strong.
Genius (Is highly skilled with magic, which requires one to understand Quantum Physics to utilize it to its fullest.Castlevania: Portrait of Ruin)
At least High 8-C, 7-B Environmental Destruction via weather control

At least Large Building level+ (Regarded as being the strongest vampire and even the most powerful creature on Earth and vastly exceeding any other vampires. Easily defeated Alucard, injuring him so much that it took him an entire year to fully recover. Even while weakened, Godbrand and Carmilla was still scared of him when Dracula threatened them. Despite him already weakened, he was able to effectively fight off and overwhelm the combined efforts of Alucard, Trevor, and Sypha for the majority of the fight and even after having his fireball deflected back at him, quickly gained the upper hand over and defeated Alucard and their their struggle vaporized the wall leaving both characters barely fazed, ultimately only being defeated due to being unable to bring himself to kill his own son and letting himself die), City level Environmental Destruction via weather control (Easily made it rain fire and meteorites across the city of Targoviste. Covered all of Targoviste in storm clouds in seconds and made it rain blood and demon corpses. Released a powerful volcano-like fireball that overwhelmed the magic of Sypha individually and required the combined effort of Trevor, Alucard and Sypha to deflect the attack back at him)
At least Relativistic+ (Easily blitzed Trevor and pinned him to the wall, who managed to react to the Stone eyed Cyclops' laser beam. Was able to react to Alucard when using his high speed technique)

At least Large Building level+ (Even in a weakened state, punches from Trevor that could affect other supernatural creatures had absolutely no effect on Dracula. Sypha's magic also proved unable to alter him significantly, with Dracula hardly reacting when she impaled him on the leg with ice constructs and only being irritated by a full-power fire blast to the face. Even Alucard was unable to inflict any lasting damage on him, despite actually injuring him. Took Trevor's Morning Star Whip and only temporarily slow him down, whereas other monsters who were hit instantly died, and took his own Fire Ball redirected at him with only moderate injuries to himself)

None notable physically (Vampiric weaknesses such as Crucifixes, Garlic and Holy Water don't affect him in the slightest). However, he is shown to be a man highly impacted by his emotions, with a tendency towards extreme violence
